31 Information Dashboard Design: R methods

31.2 Getting started

Code 
pacman::p_load(lubridate, ggthemes, reactable,
reactablefmtr, gt, gtExtras, tidyverse)

31.3 Importing Microsoft Access database

Code 
library(readr)

coffeechain <- read_rds("data/CoffeeChain.rds")

31.3.3 Data Preparation

Code 
product <- coffeechain %>%
  group_by(`Product`) %>%
  summarise(`target` = sum(`Budget Sales`),
            `current` = sum(`Sales`)) %>%
  ungroup()

31.3.4 Bullet chart in ggplot2

Code 
ggplot(product, aes(Product, current)) + 
  geom_col(aes(Product, max(target) * 1.01),
           fill="grey85", width=0.85) +
  geom_col(aes(Product, target * 0.75),
           fill="grey60", width=0.85) +
  geom_col(aes(Product, target * 0.5),
           fill="grey50", width=0.85) +
  geom_col(aes(Product, current), 
           width=0.35,
           fill = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(y = target,
                    x = Product, 
                    ymin = target,
                    ymax= target), 
                width = .4,
                colour = "yellow",
                size = 1) +
  coord_flip()

31.4 Plotting sparklines using ggplot2

31.4.1 Preparing the data

Code 
sales_report <- coffeechain %>%
  filter(Date >= "2013-01-01") %>%
  mutate(Month = month(Date)) %>%
  group_by(Month, Product) %>%
  summarise(Sales = sum(Sales)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Month, Product, Sales)
Code 
mins <- group_by(sales_report, Product) %>% 
  slice(which.min(Sales))
maxs <- group_by(sales_report, Product) %>% 
  slice(which.max(Sales))
ends <- group_by(sales_report, Product) %>% 
  filter(Month == max(Month))
Code 
quarts <- sales_report %>%
  group_by(Product) %>%
  summarise(quart1 = quantile(Sales, 
                              0.25),
            quart2 = quantile(Sales, 
                              0.75)) %>%
  right_join(sales_report)

31.4.2 sparklines in ggplot2

Code 
ggplot(sales_report, aes(x = Month, y = Sales)) + 
  facet_grid(Product ~ ., scales = "free_y") + 
  
  geom_ribbon(
    data = quarts, 
    aes(ymin = quart1, ymax = quart2), 
    fill = "#DDEEFF",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  geom_line(color = "#1F77B4", linewidth = 0.4) +
  
  geom_point(data = mins, color = "#D62728", size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = maxs, color = "#2CA02C", size = 1) +
  
  geom_text(data = mins, aes(label = Sales), color = "#D62728", vjust = -1) +
  geom_text(data = maxs, aes(label = Sales), color = "#2CA02C", vjust = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = ends, aes(label = Sales), color = "#1F77B4", hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = ends, aes(label = Product), color = "#333333", hjust = 0, nudge_x = 1.0) +
  
  expand_limits(
    x = max(sales_report$Month) + 
      (0.25 * (max(sales_report$Month) - min(sales_report$Month)))
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 12, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.1, 0)) +
  
  theme_tufte(base_size = 6, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(), 
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
    strip.text = element_blank()
  )

31.6 sparklines: gtExtras method

Code 
report <- coffeechain %>%
  mutate(Year = year(Date)) %>%
  filter(Year == "2013") %>%
  mutate (Month = month(Date, 
                        label = TRUE, 
                        abbr = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Product, Month) %>%
  summarise(Sales = sum(Sales)) %>%
  ungroup()

report %>%
  group_by(Product) %>%
  summarize('Monthly Sales' = list(Sales),

31.6.3 Combining the data.frame

Code 
spark <- report %>%
  group_by(Product) %>%
  summarize('Monthly Sales' = list(Sales), 
            .groups = "drop")
Code 
sales <- report %>% 
  group_by(Product) %>% 
  summarise("Min" = min(Sales, na.rm = T),
            "Max" = max(Sales, na.rm = T),
            "Average" = mean(Sales, na.rm = T)
            )
Code 
sales_data = left_join(sales, spark)

31.7 Interactive Information Dashboard Design: reactable and reactablefmtr methods

Code 
remotes::install_github("timelyportfolio/dataui")
Code 
library(dataui)

31.7.1 Plotting interactive sparklines

Code 
report <- report %>%
  group_by(Product) %>%
  summarize(`Monthly Sales` = list(Sales))
Code 
reactable(
  report,
  columns = list(
    Product = colDef(maxWidth = 200),
    `Monthly Sales` = colDef(
      cell = react_sparkline(report)
    )
  )
)

31.7.2 Changing the pagesize

Code 
reactable(
  report,
  defaultPageSize = 13,
  columns = list(
    Product = colDef(maxWidth = 200),
    `Monthly Sales` = colDef(
      cell = react_sparkline(report)
    )
  )
)

31.7.3 Adding points and labels

Code 
reactable(
  report,
  defaultPageSize = 13,
  columns = list(
    Product = colDef(maxWidth = 200),
    `Monthly Sales` = colDef(
      cell = react_sparkline(
        report,
        highlight_points = highlight_points(
          min = "red", max = "blue"),
        labels = c("first", "last")
        )
    )
  )
)

31.7.4 Adding reference line

Code 
reactable(
  report,
  defaultPageSize = 13,
  columns = list(
    Product = colDef(maxWidth = 200),
    `Monthly Sales` = colDef(
      cell = react_sparkline(
        report,
        highlight_points = highlight_points(
          min = "red", max = "blue"),
        statline = "mean"
        )
    )
  )
)

31.7.5 Adding bandline

Code 
reactable(
  report,
  defaultPageSize = 13,
  columns = list(
    Product = colDef(maxWidth = 200),
    `Monthly Sales` = colDef(
      cell = react_sparkline(
        report,
        highlight_points = highlight_points(
          min = "red", max = "blue"),
        line_width = 1,
        bandline = "innerquartiles",
        bandline_color = "grey"
        )
    )
  )
)

31.7.6 Changing from sparkline to sparkbar

Code 
reactable(
  report,
  defaultPageSize = 13,
  columns = list(
    Product = colDef(maxWidth = 200),
    `Monthly Sales` = colDef(
      cell = react_sparkbar(
        report,
        highlight_bars = highlight_bars(
          min = "red", max = "blue"),
        bandline = "innerquartiles",
        statline = "mean")
    )
  )
)

# 31  Information Dashboard Design: R methods

## 31.2 Getting started

```{r}
pacman::p_load(lubridate, ggthemes, reactable,
reactablefmtr, gt, gtExtras, tidyverse)
```

## 31.3 Importing Microsoft Access database

```{r}
library(readr)

coffeechain <- read_rds("data/CoffeeChain.rds")
```

## 31.3.3 Data Preparation

```{r}
product <- coffeechain %>%
  group_by(`Product`) %>%
  summarise(`target` = sum(`Budget Sales`),
            `current` = sum(`Sales`)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## 31.3.4 Bullet chart in ggplot2

```{r}
ggplot(product, aes(Product, current)) + 
  geom_col(aes(Product, max(target) * 1.01),
           fill="grey85", width=0.85) +
  geom_col(aes(Product, target * 0.75),
           fill="grey60", width=0.85) +
  geom_col(aes(Product, target * 0.5),
           fill="grey50", width=0.85) +
  geom_col(aes(Product, current), 
           width=0.35,
           fill = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(y = target,
                    x = Product, 
                    ymin = target,
                    ymax= target), 
                width = .4,
                colour = "yellow",
                size = 1) +
  coord_flip()
```

## 31.4 Plotting sparklines using ggplot2

```{r}
maxs <- group_by(sales_report, Product) %>%

ends <- group_by(sales_report, Product) %>%
```

```{r}

  ) +
```

## 31.5 Static Information Dashboard Design: gt and gtExtras methods

## 31.5.1 Plotting a simple bullet chart

```{r}
product %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt_plt_bullet(column = current, 
              target = target, 
              width = 60,
              palette = c("lightblue", 
                          "black")) %>%
  gt_theme_538()
```

## 31.6 sparklines: gtExtras method

```{r}
report <- coffeechain %>%
  mutate(Year = year(Date)) %>%
  filter(Year == "2013") %>%
  mutate (Month = month(Date, 
                        label = TRUE, 
                        abbr = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Product, Month) %>%
  summarise(Sales = sum(Sales)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
report %>%
  group_by(Product) %>%
  summarize('Monthly Sales' = list(Sales), 
            .groups = "drop")
```

## 31.6.1 Plotting Coffechain Sales report

```{r}
report %>%
  group_by(Product) %>%
  summarize('Monthly Sales' = list(Sales), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
   gt() %>%
   gt_plt_sparkline('Monthly Sales',
                    same_limit = FALSE)
```

## 31.6.2 Adding statistics

```{r}
report %>% 
  group_by(Product) %>% 
  summarise("Min" = min(Sales, na.rm = T),
            "Max" = max(Sales, na.rm = T),
            "Average" = mean(Sales, na.rm = T)
            ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = 4,
    decimals = 2)
```

## 31.6.3 Combining the data.frame

```{r}
spark <- report %>%
  group_by(Product) %>%
  summarize('Monthly Sales' = list(Sales), 
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
sales <- report %>% 
  group_by(Product) %>% 
  summarise("Min" = min(Sales, na.rm = T),
            "Max" = max(Sales, na.rm = T),
            "Average" = mean(Sales, na.rm = T)
            )
```

```{r}
sales_data = left_join(sales, spark)
```

## 31.6.4 Plotting the updated data.table

```{r}
sales_data %>%
  gt() %>%
  gt_plt_sparkline('Monthly Sales',
                   same_limit = FALSE)
```

## 31.6.5 Combining bullet chart and sparklines

```{r}
bullet <- coffeechain %>%
  filter(Date >= "2013-01-01") %>%
  group_by(`Product`) %>%
  summarise(`Target` = sum(`Budget Sales`),
            `Actual` = sum(`Sales`)) %>%
  ungroup() 
```

```{r}
sales_data = sales_data %>%
  left_join(bullet)
```

```{r}
sales_data %>%
  gt() %>%
  gt_plt_sparkline('Monthly Sales') %>%
  gt_plt_bullet(column = Actual, 
                target = Target, 
                width = 28,
                palette = c("blue", 
                          "black")) %>%
  gt_theme_538()
```

## 31.7 Interactive Information Dashboard Design: reactable and reactablefmtr methods


```{r}

```

```{r}
report <- report %>%
```
